panel.material_candidate: 2mm clear PMMA acrylic; request cast Clear000 stock, confirm with fabricator

controls.switch_note: Dailywell B1 uses a nominal 6.35 mm, 1/4-40 bushing and a keyed panel profile. A4 plain 6.50 mm finished hole is a design clearance choice. The small acrylic key tab is omitted; rear PETG cradle body anti-rotation is required. Standard nut: 7.92 mm AF, 9.19 mm AC, thickness 1.57 mm. Oversized 10.80 mm lockwasher and 11.99 mm locking ring are omitted for 2HP. Nut contact, thread engagement and carrier integration remain pending.
controls.jack_front_retention: Unthreaded nominal 6 mm barrel; no front nut or washer. A rear cradle must positively capture the body against insertion and withdrawal.
controls.stock_selection_note: Stock was checked by the parent/mechanical research agent; availability is not guaranteed. These are front interfaces only; the A3 assembly has not been regenerated.

carrier.note: Front hole locations retained. Rear PETG carrier integration must be redesigned for selected parts; no A4 rear assembly claim.

pcb.note: Front support hole retained. Lower PCB and selected-part axial stack require integration; the A3 PCB depth is not assumed.

jack.note: No jack washer or nut. OD6 is an unthreaded barrel appearance marker.

toggle.note: Dailywell standard MNU-1M01A nut. Front appearance uses the 9.19 mm corner envelope; exact face shape is schematic.

front_washers.note: Flat smooth load-spreading washer envelopes; exact stock/material and thread engagement require parts review. No serrated/conical washer contact with PMMA.

engraving.finish: Frost the full visible rear surface, leave letter strokes and mode icons clear. Front stays smooth/glossy.
engraving.mask_boolean_thickness_note: Computational aid only, NOT an engraving depth.
engraving.production_mirror: x_rear=W-x_front; keep TOP at TOP. Files are already mirrored. Do not mirror or invert again.
engraving.material: Clear cast PMMA requested; supplier must confirm stock and nominal2mm thickness. Pre-matte P422 cannot produce untouched clear letters merely by skipping engraving.
engraving.mechanical_pending: Primary cut adopts the selected Dailywell plain 6.50 mm hole and XKB 6.20 mm jack holes. Carrier anti-rotation, jack capture and stack integration remain pending. No whole-module CAD release.

limitations: A3 and earlier folders remain unchanged. The prior A4 mask on A3 holes is saved in comparison_A3_holes.
